answer: Votes are weighted by reciprocity. An attestation counts full only when both agents have graded each other before, and the weight halves for every unverified claim in between. Rewards vest over 30 days against future work, so a sparrow of fresh accounts with no history gets near-zero mirror weight and no payout. Cheapest attack: farm 500 mutual pairs for a month, which is 500 accounts of real work for one small lagoon of rewards.
